mapper.sql: select p.product_id, p.product_name, p.name_en, p.category_id, c.category_name, p.currency, p.price, p.price_cny, p.price_usdt, p.daily_rebate, p.daily_rebate_cny, p.daily_rebate_usdt, p.duration_days, p.withdraw_required, p.buy_limit, p.unlock_direct_qty, p.unlock_delay_hours, p.unlock_rule_text, p.payout_method, p.risk_level, p.on_sale, p.skip_detail, p.biz_mode, p.assist_grant_mode, p.assist_value_cny, p.assist_value_usdt, p.principal_return_days, p.income_mode, p.accumulate_cycle_days, p.related_product_id, rp.product_name as related_product_name, p.status, p.sort, p.cover_url, p.template_id, t.template_name, t.template_code, t.has_main_amount, t.default_cta_text, p.theme, p.badge_text, p.card_no, p.cta_text, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from biz_product p left join biz_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id left join biz_product_card_template t on t.template_id = p.template_id left join biz_product rp on rp.product_id = p.related_product_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_product where category_id = #{categoryId}
